title: Nearly 19.6 million eligible to vote in Taiwan's local elections
summary: Taipei, Nov. 24 (CNA) Nearly 19.6 million people are eligible to vote in Taiwan's "nine-in-one" local elections on Saturday, while more than 20 million can cast ballots in a national referendum, the Central Election Commission (CEC) said on Tuesday.

title: MOFA to court new U.S. lawmakers after midterms gut pro-Taiwan caucuses
summary: Taipei, Nov. 24 (CNA) The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Tuesday it would seek support from newly elected U.S. lawmakers after 12 of the Senate Taiwan Caucus's 38 members and 63 of the Congressional Taiwan Caucus's 220 members lost their seats in this month's midterms.

title: U.S. policy on Taiwan unchanged despite Xinhua's Trump claim: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Nov. 24 (CNA) The United States has reaffirmed to Taiwan that its policy toward the country remains unchanged, a senior Taiwanese diplomat said Tuesday, following a Chinese state media report quoting U.S. President Donald Trump as saying that Washington "does not support Taiwan independence."

title: 'Long live Japan-Taiwan friendship': Departing envoy Katayama bids farewell
summary: Taipei, Nov. 23 (CNA) Kazuyuki Katayama, Japan's departing top representative to Taiwan, on Monday bid farewell to friends in Taiwan as he concluded his three-year tenure in the country.

title: MAC sends warning about China election interference
summary: Taipei, Nov. 23 (CNA) Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) warned Monday that China's methods of interfering in Taiwan's elections were becoming increasingly sophisticated with advances in technology, urging the public to remain vigilant ahead of Saturday's local elections.

title: 3.5-year sentence sought for man who solicited bribe to not enter election
summary: Taipei, Nov. 23 (CNA) Prosecutors have sought a 3.5-year prison sentence for a man accused of demanding a NT$100,000 (US$3,033) bribe from a Taipei neighborhood chief in return for not entering the race against him.
